events.verdict: Jokic (DEN) rises up into Lovering's (MEM) arm as he contests and the arm contact is marginal.
Lovering (MEM) reaches forward and the contact with Jokic (DEN) during his put-back shot attempt is marginal.
Jokic (DEN) creates the marginal arm contact with Lovering (MEM) by veering away from his path.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) and Lovering (MEM) briefly engage and disengage following the pick.
Caldwell-Pope (MEM) makes contact to the ball to deflect it away from Braun (DEN).
Murray (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Pippen Jr.'s (MEM) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Lovering (MEM) contests Jokic's (DEN) floater attempt and the contact after Jokic returns to the floor is incidental.
Braun (DEN) moves alongside of Pippen Jr.'s (MEM) path to the basket and the body contact during his shot attempt is marginal.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN).
Jokic (DEN) commits a take foul on Lovering (MEM).
Valanciunas (DEN) and Jackson (MEM) lock arms during the rebound and Jackson loses his balance on his own after deflecting the loose ball.
Prosper (MEM) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN).
Jokic (DEN) legally contests Pippen Jr.'s (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) avoids making any illegal contact with Jackson (MEM) during his shot attempt near the rim.
